title: Validate complete audit
notes: reports and explicit own exceptions; preserve compiler alias origins.
result: Validate subprocess results and complete consistent audit reports before applying the unchanged dated advisory policy. Reject inherited exception properties while preserving explicit own entries and numeric fallback. No threshold, waiver or expiry changed. Compiler-owned alias origins, workspace discovery, temporary-file ownership and the typed standalone cruise helper are also verified; package publication remains separate.
evidence: Original quality-config lint and native type checks passed; pnpm run test --maxWorkers=2 passed all 106 tests across 20 files. Exact packed tarball passed license, strict publint and type analysis, strict external consumer and shipped runtime checks. Packaged synthetic audit cases returned error=2, inherited-exception=1 and valid-empty=0. Actual pnpm run deps:graph and pnpm run deps:graph:aliased both exited 0; the former retained 127 dev-dependency warnings, and the latter found no orphans across six workspaces. Source, dependency identities and temporary-file cleanup were verified.
